description: A Bot's tasks, on the side panel's Tasks page (Baude's) and the Android app's, and what their host says of their runs: scripts run by hand or as a trigger fires, their inputs, their runs and their logs.

messages.title: Tasks
messages.status: .input {$status :string} .match $status running {{running}} asking {{asking its Bot}} done {{done}} failed {{failed}} stopped {{stopped}} skipped {{skipped}} * {{{$status}}}
messages.couldnt: .input {$doing :string} .match $doing load {{Couldn't load the tasks.}} run {{Couldn't run the task.}} save {{Couldn't save the task.}} delete {{Couldn't delete the task.}} stop {{Couldn't stop the run.}} * {{Couldn't {$doing} the task.}}
messages.asked: .input {$error :string} .match $error error {{An instance of the '{$name}' task failed}} done {{An instance of the '{$name}' task finished}} * {{An instance of the '{$name}' task asks:}}
messages.still_running: skipped: its last run is still going
messages.finished: This is for your information; nothing is asked of you.
messages.answer_with: Answer with your answer_task tool, these fields in its answer:
messages.answer_with_text: Answer with your answer_task tool, in its text.
messages.answer_reminder: You haven't answered run {$run} with your answer_task tool, and the task's waiting on it. Answer with the tool now.
messages.answer_no_text: an ask with no form is answered in text
messages.not_answered: its Bot didn't answer with its answer_task tool
messages.agent_waiting: Still waiting to tell {$bot} what {$name} said: {$bot} has been busy for an hour
